task: Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/quiet.wav already loaded as a single mono 44.1 kHz audio track. The track is a quiet 3-second 440 Hz sine tone with peak amplitude near -20 dBFS. Select the entire audio and apply an Amplify effect with +6.0 dB amplification. Then export the result to /home/user/Music/amplified.wav as a mono 44100 Hz 16-bit PCM WAV file.

verification.description: Peak amplitude boosted to near -14 dBFS (source was -20 dBFS, +6 dB applied)
Dominant frequency still 440 Hz (amplify preserves frequency)

cli_feasibility.translation: Using cli-anything-audacity: track management → clip import/add → selection management → effect add amplify → metadata tag settings → export render operation
